data.name: Riyaj
data.gender_notes: Riyaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules or governs. The name Riyaj carries the meaning “King, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Riyaj usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a spiritual leader or ruler
data.etymology: Riyaj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Riyaj total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
